overview: In the yard you opened a clean leaf and wrote three phrases: buds, a grey gown ten paces off, and three answers at a brook. You added no line of verse under them.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the three phrases and added nothing further.

assets.name: the writing-tables
assets.disposition: Wrote three phrases on a clean leaf
